senses.gloss: dhurā-tuṇḍa, ˚ḍaka, m. (= Skt. dhūs-tuṇḍa), the tip of the wagon-pole: MSV 〔ii.71.7〕 (˚ḍo), 10 (˚ḍakena).
Dhurānikṣepaṇa (ed. ˚na), nt., n. of a caitya in the general region of Vaiśālī: Divy 〔201.5, 14〕.
? dhurdhūraka, n. of some plant: ˚kasya tu mūlāni Mmk 〔556.24〕; ˚ka-mūlaṃ juhuyād ekaṃ 〔557.14〕; each phrase should constitute the first half of an anuṣṭubh line, the meter being bad both times.
